verdict.headline: This result is indistinguishable from the best of a large number of coin flips.
reasons: The search ran 3,456 trials, which lifts the bar a winner has to clear from a Sharpe of 0 to a Sharpe of 0.98.
The observed Sharpe of 1.47 deflates to a 75% probability that the true Sharpe is above that bar.
Across every symmetric split of the sample, the in-sample winner finished below the out-of-sample median 59% of the time. One half is what pure chance looks like.
At this Sharpe and these higher moments, 11.9 years of track record would be needed to clear the bar at 95 percent confidence.
